# Complete control coverage — 22 of 22

> Updated by kit **04p1**. The [designer answers](DESIGNER-ANSWERS-04p1.md) and [patch changelog](CHANGELOG-04p1.md) supersede earlier placement, completion-cost, plain-mode and overlay guidance below. Original renders in `preview/renders` document kit 04; current verification renders are in `preview/patch-renders`.

The supplied component owns presentation and short-lived presentation state only. Field paths below are `ReviewModel` paths. Actions are the exact `onAction` discriminants; file and preferences have separate callbacks. Every displayed string is React text, never raw HTML.

## Consolidations that intentionally change the old picture

The playbook selector is on the toaster. Intensity and footnotes live on the register. The filename appears on the bread only within the appliance; the same filename can legitimately occur in an exported receipt or History record. The instructions stay on the pad. The register owns the only receipt printer.

The visible lever is itself a native, text-labelled button, so there is one obvious Start/Stop action. Its drag behavior is supplemental. The always-present plain mode uses the same controls and model; it does not maintain a second copy of preferences. This replaces the earlier requirement for a separate redundant Start button and for playbook radios with a native select for an unbounded catalog. Both changes follow the owner's latest direction and require corresponding legacy layout/test assertions to be updated.

## Error route coverage

Submit/file rejection, no active catalog, preference-save warning, poll error, cancellation delivery error/race, download storage failure, cover generation failure, disposition save failure and clipboard/download confirmation all have an explicit surface. Populate `messages` with classified user-safe text and an allowed retry action. Do not concatenate raw server exceptions or sensitive document excerpts.
